verdict.rationale: Svelte's compiler-based approach ('efficient JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM', minimal work in the browser) and community reports of reduced bundle size/performance vs React (svelte-comm-8) support small, dependency-light output, but there is no explicit evidence pack data on runtime footprint size, zero-dependency claims, or supply-chain security posture. missing for 10: quantified bundle-size benchmarks, explicit no-runtime-dependency documentation, supply-chain security discussion (SBOM, audit, dependency count).
